record_title: Exact Steinberg tensor covering exponent for PGL_n(q)
limitations: Originality is asserted only to the best of our knowledge. The main input is the very recent preprint arXiv:2609.17319v1, so a concurrent or subsequent observation may supersede the novelty claim. The cube argument is short once the new Steinberg-square support theorem is available, and an older equivalent statement under different terminology remains possible. No independent validation is asserted.
